aboutText: Since opening our doors in Footscray in 2002, we at Autoclass have quickly made a name for ourselves with honest, reliable and affordable repairs. Now based at 18 Cranwell St in Braybrook, we service all makes and models of vehicles, giving our customers the peace of mind that comes with professional workmanship and friendly customer service at a competitive price.
servicesText: From routine servicing to complex engine repairs, Autoclass Service Centre provides the full spectrum of mechanical work for all makes and models across Braybrook and Melbourne's west.

services.title: Logbook Servicing
services.desc: Manufacturer-specified servicing that keeps your warranty intact and your vehicle running at its best.

services.title: Brake Repairs
services.desc: Complete brake inspections, pad replacements and rotor resurfacing for safe and reliable stopping power.

services.title: Engine Diagnostics
services.desc: Advanced computer diagnostics to accurately pinpoint issues and get your engine running smoothly again.

services.title: Transmission Servicing
services.desc: Automatic and manual transmission repairs, fluid changes and clutch replacements by experienced mechanics.

services.title: Suspension & Steering
services.desc: Shock absorber replacements, wheel alignments and steering component repairs for a comfortable, safe ride.

services.title: Cooling System Repairs
services.desc: Radiator replacements, coolant flushes and hose repairs to prevent overheating and costly engine damage.

reviews.text: Been taking my car to Autoclass in Braybrook for years. They do all my logbook servicing and always explain exactly what needs doing without pushing unnecessary work. Genuinely honest mechanics.
reviews.name: Dave Mitchell

reviews.text: They diagnosed a tricky engine misfire that two other shops missed. Fair pricing and the team at Autoclass in Cranwell St were really friendly and professional throughout the whole process.
reviews.name: Sarah Nguyen

reviews.text: We use Autoclass for our entire fleet of delivery vehicles. Their brake repairs and regular servicing keep everything on the road. Reliable, quick turnaround and always great value.
reviews.name: James O'Connell
